steps: Verify current base, P2.1/P2.2/P2.3 accepted scopes, task prerequisites and source/gap coverage.

The synthetic directed graph and Macro/Micro interval accounting constraints pass.
Full harness passes on the integrated review base.

P2.1, P2.2, and P2.3 entries and acceptance receipts are complete at their stated evidence/gap-inventory scope.
Every P2.3 active unknown has a concrete acquisition plan and every linked claim is source bounded; no empirical ED default or unsourced value is accepted.
Deferred congestion and optional-complexity inputs remain deferred.
All three packet verification commands pass and independent review findings are recorded.
P2/P-R2 exit claims do not imply empirical transferability, clinical validity, runtime use, Cairns applicability or whole-track completion.

Any unknown active row lacks an acquisition plan or any source-backed claim cannot be scoped to its source.
Manual check would require fabricating a real interval or treating synthetic timing as observed.
